summary: Tested Personnel Month-End Closing module end-to-end (backend + frontend). 11/11 pytest backend tests pass (100%). UI flows verified: People Ops route, Business Clarity dropdown, 3-panel detail dialog with correct pool computation (102,600 × 19% = RD$19,494) and per-employee distribution. All required data-testids present and functional.

integration_issues.flow: Detail dialog — live grand-total during editing
integration_issues.issue: While editing distribution (adding employee, typing pct) the per-row 'Amount' updates locally (Pool $ × pct%) but the 'Grand Total' / 'Total Incentives' / Extras (Panel 3) table only refresh after clicking Save (round-trip to backend breakdown). UX-wise this can confuse the user who sees row Amount=RD$19,494 while Grand Total still says RD$0 until save. Acceptable but worth a local recompute to feel responsive.

issues: React a11y warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add DialogDescription to the Dialogs for screen-reader compliance (non-blocking).

BC dropdown trigger label shows 'Close' in English even though the user originally requested 'Cierre' label. UI follows i18n (isEs flag); when language='en' the trigger is 'Close'. This is expected, but if you want 'Cierre' always visible in BC nav (per the original spec), the trigger label currently does not honor the isEs override the way the section header does.

action_items: Consider local recompute of grand_total/totals while editing distribution (don't wait for Save) — minor UX improvement.
Add DialogDescription to MonthEndClosingSection's create dialog and MonthEndDetail dialog to clear a11y warnings.
Optional: ensure BC dropdown trigger label respects isEs (show 'Cierre' when isEs).
critical_code_review_comments: month_end_closing.py is clean (367 lines, well-structured, async, _id excluded). No blocking issues.
Access helper _resolve_company_and_access correctly handles admin/owner/hr + employees.is_manager fallback.
Reopen endpoint correctly enforces owner/admin only (line 323).
Snapshot stored at close time (line 309) preserves immutable breakdown — correct.
Soft validation on pct sum (no rejection) — distribution_pct_sum exposed in breakdown for UI feedback — matches spec.
Duplicate (year,month) check returns 409 with informative detail message — correct.
OT extras pulled from overtime_requests with status approved/processed in YYYY-MM-DD range — correct.
Frontend MonthEndClosingSection.js uses axios with withCredentials and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — correct.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
